overlap_why.inv_pits: his scene is a covered pit trap: the pit is the stage the rescue ladder goes into
overlap_why.inv_prison_no_bed: his scene ends with the fallen as prisoners in the pit; capture is how the raid ends

coverage_rest.why: rivers share nothing with the raids or the garden and add one capability; a river scene checks it directly
one liquid's property; a two-canal crossing timing is cheaper than a showcase built round it
a dig yields a find or not: one cut on the right stone checks it
a map-maker tool; the source scene drives the Sink tap and flow meter and its zero-rate control checks they do what they say
the walk turns the master switch off and on mid-game; per-toggle checks are the floor's mod_settings line
